back_translation: The oracle that Habakkuk the prophet received in a vision.
O LORD, how long shall I cry for help, and You will not hear? I cry out to You, 'Violence!' but You do not save.
Why do You make me see iniquity and look upon trouble? Destruction and violence are before me; strife and contention arise.
Therefore the law is slack and powerless, and justice never goes forth; for the wicked surround the righteous, so justice comes out perverted.
Look among the nations, observe, and be utterly astounded, for I am about to do something in your days that you would not believe even if you were told.
For behold, I am rousing up the Chaldeans, that fierce and impetuous nation, who march across the breadth of the earth to seize dwellings not their own.
That nation is dreadful and fearsome; its justice and dignity proceed from itself.
Their horses are swifter than leopards and fiercer than evening wolves; their horsemen charge ahead, coming from far away; they fly like an eagle swooping to devour.
They all come for violence, their faces set forward, and they gather captives like sand.
He scoffs at kings, and rulers are an object of his mockery; he laughs at every fortress, heaps up earth, and captures it.
Then he sweeps past like the wind—a guilty man who makes his own strength his god.
O LORD my God, my Holy One, are You not from everlasting? We shall not die. O LORD, You have appointed them for judgment; O Rock, You have established them for correction.
You whose eyes are too pure to look upon evil, who cannot bear to gaze on wrong—why do You disregard the treacherous and stay silent when the wicked swallows up one more righteous than himself?
You have made mankind like the fish of the sea, like crawling things that have no ruler.
The enemy hauls all of them up with a hook, drags them away in his net, and gathers them in his dragnet; therefore he rejoices and is glad.
Therefore he sacrifices to his net and burns incense to his dragnet, for by them he gains an abundant portion and rich food.
Will he keep emptying his net and mercilessly slaughtering nations forever?
